item.title: Struggling to make its voice heard: Can the EU forge a true foreign policy?
item.description: "Who do I call if I want to speak to Europe?" The famous quote attributed to Henry Kissinger still resonates today. There is in fact a Mrs Europe on the world stage: Kaja Kallas, the EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy. She is actually the sixth high representative. But ever since that post was created, rivalries between different centres of power have diluted the EU's ability to speak with one voice. We saw that recently with tensions over who should represent the EU in any potential talks with Russia. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Dos trabajadores nepalíes fueron rescatados con vida este viernes 4 de septiembre del proyecto hidroeléctrico Trishuli-3A, en el noveno día del operativo de búsqueda tras la letal riada del 26 de agosto. Ambos fueron hospitalizados en la capital, uno de ellos en estado crítico, según las autoridades. Uno de los sobrevivientes aseguró que hay más personas vivas al interior del túnel, mientras los organismos de emergencia luchan contra el lodo y el tiempo para extraer a cientos de empleados atrapados bajo tierra. item.title: Latcho Drom director Tony Gatlif dies aged 77
item.description: Film-maker acclaimed for his celebrations of Roma culture had been working on a ‘historical film project’ in Provence Tony Gatlif, the French director of more than 20 films that mostly concentrated on celebrating Roma culture across the world, has died aged 77. His family said in a statement to AFP that Gatlif died on Wednesday of “a health issue” while working on a “historical film project” in Arles in Provence, France. “The beauty of his films, his generosity, his joy, his poetry, and his love of music will remain with us forever.” Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Strength of Meloni less linked to policy, more about her party's dominance within govt coalition
